svg.text: (a) Break-even per function, one marker per run
The three runs of the replicate series. (a) 43 functions that repay in at least one run; markers per run, bar = range, tick =
median; crosses = validated but not faster than Python. For 27 functions repaying in >= 2 runs the max/min ratio has median 1.6;
10 repay in one run and never in another. 12 further functions never repay in any run. (b) Boxes are log-scale quartiles,
